Callout.Name: Illegal Fire at a Campsite
Callout.Message: Large fire at a campsite in a restricted area.
Callout.Advisory: Six campers, fire well established, no injuries.

Script.Line: It is not ours. It was already going when we got here.
There are three tents inside the ring and nobody in them.
The wind is taking it towards the trees.

Lines.Approach: Six of them around a fire that is far bigger than the rules allow. Wind is coming up.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
